sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Requires a bachelor's degree in a manufacturing management-related major, or industrial or quality engineering major, and three to five years related experience; or a combination of education and experience.
* Requires experience in the Quality Sciences, problem solving tools, and project management.
* Robust background in quality and developing quality systems preferred.
* Previous leadership or management experinece strongly desired.
